summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 24, 2026, with first-half 2026 operational and financial results. The update covers Phase 1 NSCLC data (79% one-year locoregional control), a Johnson & Johnson-led Phase 2 CONVERGE study and Phase 3 NANORAY-312 protocol amendment, plus an oversubscribed ~86 million global follow-on offering completed in May 2026 and 110.9 million in cash as of June 30, 2026. No special-situation transaction is announced; the filing is a routine interim business and earnings update.
